results.title: The Impact of Corporate ESG Performance on Supply Chain ... - MDPI
results.content: [Table 3](https://www.mdpi.com/2071-1050/17/10/4418#sustainability-17-04418-t003) reports the impact of corporate ESG performance on supply chain resilience. The results in Column (2) of [Table 5](https://www.mdpi.com/2071-1050/17/10/4418#sustainability-17-04418-t005) show that the direction and significance of the impact of corporate ESG performance on supply chain resilience remained unchanged, indicating that ESG performance continued to significantly enhance supply chain resilience. Furthermore, by comparing the data in Columns (1) and (3) of [Table 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2071-1050/17/10/4418#sustainability-17-04418-t006), it can be observed that the direct effect of ESG performance on supply chain resilience decreases slightly (from 0.153 to 0.148). According to the regression results in [Table 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2071-1050/17/10/4418#sustainability-17-04418-t008), the coefficients of ESG performance on supply chain resilience were positive for both SOEs and non-SOEs and were statistically significant at the 1% level.
